title: Yaad Aaogi Zahra
body:
kaandhe pe liye binte payambar ka janaza
jab jane lage suye baqaiyya mere maula
tha kul ke madadgaar ke honton pe ye nauha
yaad aaogi zahra yaad aaogi zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt baqayya se mai ghar jaaunga zahra
phat jayega seene mein masayib se kaleja
darwaze pe pahunchunga to phir zabt na hoga
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaze ki keelon pe nazar jayegi jis dam
bad jayega ay maadar e hasnain mera gham
chaa jayega hyder ki nigahon mein andhera
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadme ki churi dil pe har ek waqt chalegi
kunfuz ki jafa hashr talak yaad rahegi
jab jab bhi musalle pe mai tasbeeh padhunga
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghut ghut ke wo rona wo sisakne ki sadayein
wo dard ki shiddat wo aziyat wo karahein
mai bhool na paunga tumhara wo tadapna
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
har tarha se bacchon ko sambhalunga mai bibi
naazon se bade pyar se paalunga mai bibi
bin aap ke khayenge na jis waqt wo khaana
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadma mujhe mohsin ke guzarne ka rahega
aansu nahi aankhon se meri khoon bahega
aayega mere saamne jab bhi koi baccha
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat mein musibat mein mera saath nibhaya
zakhmi thi magar mujhko layeeno se bachaya
yaad aayega har waqt ye ehsaan tumhara
yaad aaogi zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot jo zahra ka rakha laa ke zameen par
roye hai bahot dayr talak saaqi e kausar
waiz tha yehi hyder e karrar ka naala
yaad aaogi zahra...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
